trust_decision.summary: Whether a leaf/intermediate DNS SAN lies inside a CA's nameConstraints permittedSubtrees (and outside excludedSubtrees) is decided in NameChain::evaluate_single_constraint via DNSConstraint::matches; at the pinned commit a wildcard SAN is not parsed as a pattern and is rejected as a malformed SAN, so the wildcard-escape flaw is NOT present at the pinned commit

landing_point.why: The DNSName/DNSName arm of evaluate_single_constraint is where DNS SANs meet name constraints; the summary names permittedSubtrees and wildcard DNS names

fix_sites.entry_point: same verify() path; permittedSubtrees loop in evaluate_constraints (commit 2 passes SubtreeKind::Permitted)
same verify() path; excludedSubtrees loop (commit 2 passes SubtreeKind::Excluded)
DNSConstraint::matches (pub type in pub types module), reached via verify()

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: Both fix files sit in one crate, src/rust/cryptography-x509-verification/src/; no second implementation of DNS name-constraint matching found (the only other DNSPattern use is subject/SAN matching at src/rust/cryptography-x509-verification/src/policy/mod.rs:183, which is a different sink)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: unknown: at the pinned commit there is no wildcard route to dismiss, because wildcard SANs fail DNSName::new (src/rust/cryptography-x509-verification/src/types.rs:53-56) and are rejected (src/rust/cryptography-x509-verification/src/lib.rs:161-164); the only plausible argument, that excludedSubtrees need overlap semantics and not containment, belongs to code that does not exist yet

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: excludedSubtrees must still match a wildcard SAN when the two overlap (e.g. constraint bar.example.com vs *.example.com), and wildcard SANs under a permitting parent (example.com or com) must still verify; reusing permits() for excluded, or rejecting all wildcards, breaks one of these

O6_input_shapes: wildcard DNS SAN *.X (DNSPattern::Wildcard) vs a permitted constraint more specific than X
wildcard DNS SAN vs an excluded constraint (overlap semantics)

O7_producer.where: SANs are collected in NameChain::new from certificate extensions (src/rust/cryptography-x509-verification/src/lib.rs:130-146); no schema, serializer or cache involved

O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Same match arm structure and the same pattern/constraint naming; a maintainer adding looser host matching to RFC822Constraint could repeat the overlap shortcut
